face.name: 酸喉
face.text: 每当有敌方随从受到伤害时，将其消灭。
face.flavorText: 在老伙计恐鳞的帮助下，酸喉能够轻易地咬穿板甲。看来有些骑士要倒大霉了！

face.name: Acidmaw
face.text: Whenever an enemy minion takes damage, destroy it.
face.flavorText: With the help of his trusty sidekick Dreadscale, the giant jormungar Acidmaw is ready to face any knight!

face.name: 克洛玛古斯
face.text: 每当你抽一张牌时，将该牌的另一张复制置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 当两个头都无法说服对方晚餐到底吃什么的时候，它通常都会去拉面店解决问题。

face.name: Chromaggus
face.text: Whenever you draw a card, put another copy into your hand.
face.flavorText: Left head and right head can never agree about what to eat for dinner, so they always end up just eating ramen again.

face.name: 观星者露娜
face.text: 在你使用最右边的一张手牌后，抽 一张牌。
face.flavorText: 她是砰砰博士的左右手。准确来讲，是右手。

face.name: Stargazer Luna
face.text: After you play the right-most card in your hand, draw a card.

face.name: “鲨鱼”加佐
face.text: 每当本随从攻击时，双方玩家抽若干数量的牌，直到拥有三张手牌。
face.flavorText: “乐善好施”的加佐在加基森做信贷方面的生意，他提供的贷款无需任何抵押。但你要是没能及时还上钱，缺胳膊少腿也是常有的事，这也是他“鲨鱼”名号的由来。

face.name: Genzo, the Shark
face.text: Whenever this attacks, both players draw until they have 3 cards.
face.flavorText: Infamous in the seedy underground card rooms of Gadgetzan, he got his nickname winning the coveted Shark Plushie in the city's first Hearthstone tournament.

face.name: 加兹瑞拉
face.text: 每当本随从受到伤害，其攻击力翻倍。
face.flavorText: 祖尔法拉克队是本届巨魔世界杯的夺冠热门球队，他们的队旗上描绘着令人望而生畏的多头蛇加兹瑞拉。

face.name: Gahz'rilla
face.text: Whenever this minion takes damage, double its Attack.
face.flavorText: The Sen'jin High football team is The Gahz'rillas.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

policies: Acidmaw uses original positive enemy-minion damage notifications and guarded destruction of the captured original residence.
Chromaggus binds each actual original physical draw; captured current hand material or printed base draw-cast copies use ordinary CopyCard and do not create new draws.
Luna reads the original completed paid hand position; the original physical play counts once including a countered play, self-entry and opponent plays are excluded.
Genzo uses original attack-declaration facts and quotes each player missing-to-three draw count at that notification, controller first; ordinary Draw handles replacement, burns and fatigue.
Gahzrilla uses guarded current-stat doubling on the original physical minion; each damage trigger doubles its then-current attack through the existing DoubleStats executor.
uncertainties: Precise CN reaction ordering, drawn-card transformations and minion local-copy inheritance follow existing local policies pending calibration.
Genzo quotes the original missing count rather than an additional per-draw loop; interactions where other triggers change hand size during the refill remain an explicit pending-CN rule boundary.
No change to complete732 membership, no partial MIS_701 source binding or executable-subset pool; other source domains and deferred version/hotfix/CN edges remain open.
